stem.text: A vertical tube, closed at one end, is immersed in water. A column of air is trapped inside the tube.

stem.alt: Vertical tube containing an air column, immersed in water, with lengths 20.0 cm, 30.0 cm and 30.0 cm marked; labelled water, water surface, air and vertical tube.

stem.text: The density of water is $1000\,\text{kg m}^{-3}$.
What is the difference between the pressure of the air in the tube and the atmospheric pressure?
